summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AstraZeneca PLC announcing that the CHMP has recommended camizestrant (in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor) for EU approval to treat advanced breast cancer. The filing describes the positive opinion based on SERENA-6 Phase III trial results showing a 56% reduction in disease progression risk. No corporate transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; it is a routine regulatory milestone press release. The presentation is a foreign private issuer report of a product development update with no deal terms or financial structure. There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return event.
